# Friday small groups {.unnumbered}

[One hour every Friday, expected, in one of four time slots · open discussion, led by you]{.subtitle .lead}

The Friday group is part of each week, along with your 3 hours of sessions.
Sign up for one time slot in the Canvas Calendar each week; your group can
change from week to week.

Friday is an open discussion. You bring the topics: something AI helped you
learn this week, something you caught it getting wrong, a question from a
chapter or a talk, or a situation you saw on a rotation. Talking about AI with
an attending, a colleague, a patient, or an interviewer is a skill, and it gets
better when you practise it out loud. The groups are not recorded, so you can
try ideas and get them wrong.

Leave out anything that could identify a patient (see [the patient information
page](patient-information.qmd)).

**Week 3 (October 30): bring your clinical stories.** Bring a situation where
AI helped or hurt in patient care: one you saw, one you heard about, or one
from the news. You lead the discussion. The co-directors join some of the
groups.

**Week 4 (November 6).** The last group is for your five-minute "what you will
keep" presentations from the [learning journal](learning-journal.qmd). If you
cannot come that day, submitting the piece in Canvas is enough.
